public_boundary.registration: explicit caller-side as_register_provider_v0 only; no installed registry entry

report.canonical: sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan false, no trailing newline

invariants: Fixed v0 format only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160 samples. No adapter-sized frame variant is defined; the installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
The C provider is task-local, OFF by default and unregistered. ON requires explicit caller-side registration on one registry.
Notch plus bounded margin is compared with a fixed -5 dB gain control on identical recursive program, path, delay and nonlinear conditions; no result is omitted.
Missing, malformed, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong-shape, stale-epoch and wrong-position inputs fail explicitly with state unchanged.
Notch and margin state is per session, finite, resettable, bounded to the configured floor and released after sustained absence of a peak.
All material is synthetic and model-free. No real audio, device, model, listening, MOS/STOI, target pacing, CPU/deadline, benchmark or release claim is made.
Canonical report and output digests are byte-identical when regenerated from the pinned fixture.
release_gates: Closed-loop measured loudspeaker/microphone evidence with pinned IRs, gain-before-feedback, delay drift, path changes and nonlinear saturation
Speaker/path-held-out speech and music false-trigger plus authorized intelligibility/quality assessment
Maximum stable gain, residual tone, attack/release, clipping, latency and CPU/memory on the intended target runtime
Provider intake, license/rights, descriptor and public catalog review before any default or installed provider
Benchmark bundle creation and validation under the current submission policy before any hosted claim
